summary: Configured node1 with a rootless Nginx container under the locked appsvc account. It serves HTTP on port 8080 and automatically recovered after a full node reboot with no appsvc login session.
actions_performed: Created appsvc with /sbin/nologin and subordinate UID/GID ranges.
Created a rootless Podman Quadlet with automatic restart and boot activation.
Verified HTTP 200 on node1’s managed IP and port 8080.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified a changed boot identity and complete service recovery.

evidence.requirement: Containerized web application runs as unprivileged appsvc and serves on port 8080
evidence.summary: Shows appsvc-owned container processes, active rootless Podman container, 0.0.0.0:8080 listener, and HTTP 200 responses.

evidence.requirement: Application starts at boot without an active appsvc login session
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, linger=yes, login_sessions=0, the appsvc user manager and webapp service are active, and HTTP succeeds.

Captures healthy baseline with boot ID 437b338f-0902-4c11-86df-0a6ea6308b8e, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID fb6fa0a4-ab13-49f1-8689-43fb50e9b4bf, and recovered container, listener, user service, and HTTP response.
